risk: Trading in derivatives, including rolling spot Foreign Exchange (FX) and Contracts for Difference (CFDs), is highly speculative, carries a substantial degree of risk, and is not appropriate for every investor. Nothing on this website constitutes investment advice or a recommendation, and it has been prepared without regard to your individual objectives, financial circumstances or needs.

FX and CFDs are complex instruments dealt on a margined basis and carry a high risk of losing money rapidly by reason of leverage, which magnifies gains and losses alike. You may lose part or all of your invested capital, and losses may exceed your initial investment. Before trading, you should consider your objectives, financial position, level of experience and appetite for risk, satisfy yourself that you understand how these products operate, and trade only with funds you can afford to lose. Seek independent financial or tax advice if in any doubt. Past performance is not indicative of future results.

Products and services available under one entity may not be available under another entity. Each entity within the GTC Financial Group is a separate legal entity. A licence held by one entity does not extend to any other entity within the group.

ack.title: Important information for UAE residents
points: This website is provided for general information only. Nothing on it is an offer, solicitation or recommendation to buy or sell any financial product or service in the United Arab Emirates, and nothing on it is investment advice.

Financial products and services are made available in the UAE only where permitted by the UAE Capital Market Authority (CMA) and other applicable laws, and only to persons who meet the relevant client classification requirements.
The category you select here does not by itself make you eligible for any product or service. Your classification is assessed and confirmed by GTCFX during onboarding.
Category 5 (marketing) visitors are shown marketing and introduction information only. No trading, investment or account-opening services are offered to them.
Derivatives and leveraged products, such as CFDs, carry a high level of risk and can result in losses exceeding your initial deposit. They are not suitable for all investors.
